In this 2013-era PostgreSQL (pre-9.6/11 fast default), adding a column with a default and NOT NULL forces a full table rewrite under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, blocking reads and writes on a large posts table. records.issue_text: Broken origin check in public postMessage protocol (embed.js:16-18): substring check `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` is spoofable — attacker origin like `http://eviltrout.com.evil.com` passes, letting arbitrary pages control the embed frame's dimensions via resize messages
records.rationale: embed.js adds `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` for postMessage validation. The code is verbatim in the diff and the mechanism (indexOf vs strict equality) is real, though impact is limited to controlling iframe height.
